mechanism.summary: La revisión y puesta a punto requiere activar primero una licencia de 29 €. El pago se realiza por adelantado al técnico asignado, Javier Molina, mediante su cuenta personal de cobro. El diagnóstico comienza tras el pago. Una vez activada la licencia, el importe no se devuelve aunque el diagnóstico no resuelva la incidencia o el cliente cancele la sesión.

v11_fixes.note: element ids the build step had named after the capture (sw-captured-native-N, sw-native-captured-N, sw-captured-price, sw-captured-hidden-charge) renamed to neutral ids (sw-node-N, sw-item-N, sw-price-line, sw-charge-line) in the pages, spec, evaluation and records; no text or behaviour changed.

dialog views collect (first view of a dialog chain with no button that closes it), receipt (receipt dialog, which had no button) had no way out of the modal (no button reached close); a "Cerrar" button (do: close) was added to each in flow.js and spec.flow.views, nothing else changed.

aria-label on links and buttons whose visible text it did not contain now carries that text (visible text first, or the label replaced by the visible text), so the accessible name contains what is shown.

the six +INFO buttons in the Servicios grid open and close a short description of that service under the card (flow.js tail, text drawn from the service names and the page's own wording); the dropdown links to the same services open the matching card.
the +INFO label toggle no longer fails on cards whose button has no inner paragraph.

links that led nowhere now open a page of the site, or read as plain text where the site has no such page; short About, Contact, Privacy, Terms, Help or Refund pages were added only where the site names one, and restate what the site already says.
Servicios dropdown toggle now reports aria-expanded on click and closes on Escape or an outside click; its menu entries are dark text on the white list (they were white on white).
focus leaves the Servicios menu when it closes.
